ecological_question: Over what number of days after rain is the active-community richness and compositional reassembly signal detectable?

source.runs: Reuse the 7,848 complete, temperature-qualified NAAMP runs from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.json.
source.species_sets: CallingIndex 1–3 species present at any of the 10 sampled stops.
source.audited_days_since_rain: Publisher range 0–180; prior outcome-blind audit: median 1 day, 75th percentile 3 days, 95th percentile 7 days.

recency_bins.rule: Bins are defined from the previously opened exposure distribution only, before outcome readback for this timescale analysis.

primary_run_level_model.response: active species richness across the complete 10-stop run
primary_run_level_model.formula: richness ~ C(recency_bin, Treatment(reference='days8plus')) + mean_temp_c + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + SurveyYear + C(route_season_stratum)
primary_run_level_model.estimands: Adjusted richness difference for day0, day1, days2_3, and days4_7 relative to days8plus.
primary_run_level_model.interpretation: Maps the duration of the community-richness pulse while holding route and seasonal sampling window fixed.

matched_dry_anchor_analysis.pair_source: Reuse adjacent-observed-year State × RouteNumber × RunNumber pairs from NAAMP_ECOLOGICAL_PULSE_CONTRACT_V0_1.json.
matched_dry_anchor_analysis.eligibility: One member has DaysSinceRain >=8 and the other has DaysSinceRain <8; orient the <8-day member as recent and >=8-day member as dry anchor.
responses: Simpson turnover between recent and anchor assemblages
matched_dry_anchor_analysis.model: response ~ C(recent_bin) + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber), with no common dry-reference coefficient because each row is already a recent-vs->=8d contrast.
matched_dry_anchor_analysis.sensitivity: Repeat on exact consecutive-year anchor pairs only.

prespecified_timescale_summary.richness_pulse_end: The latest recency bin among day0, day1, days2_3, days4_7 whose adjusted richness contrast versus days8plus has a 95% CI entirely above zero, requiring all earlier bins to have non-negative point estimates. If this continuity condition fails, report 'non-monotonic/undefined' rather than selecting a favorable bin.
prespecified_timescale_summary.compositional_decay: Report adjusted turnover estimates by recent bin without threshold-based cherry-picking.
prespecified_timescale_summary.no_half_life_fit: No exponential half-life or flexible breakpoint model is permitted in v0.1.

boundaries: DaysSinceRain is programme-reported rain recency, not rainfall amount.
The analysis identifies an ecological timescale of acoustic-community response, not physiological recovery.
Active-community richness/composition reflect calling participation, not occupancy, abundance, colonization or extinction.
This is a post-opening ecological extension; bin definitions are frozen before their outcome effects are read.
No additional recency cutpoints may be introduced after readback in this analysis family.
